svg.title: ChronoNote app icon — concept A (checkbox clock)
svg.desc: The open-action glyph as a rounded square, with clock hands set inside it: the action list and the passage of days in one mark. Shipped treatment is a white knockout on the accent-blue tile (evolves the previous white-clock-on-blue icon). For a neutral-tile variant that follows the in-app colour setting, see docs/design/icon-proposals.html concept A.
